title: Illinois Hospital Uninsured Patient Discount Act (210 ILCS 89)
asOf: As described by the Illinois Hospital Report Card (state site); statute text on ilga.gov was unreachable on 2026-10-18

rules.title: Uninsured discounts up to 600% FPL
rules.plain: Illinois hospitals must discount bills for uninsured Illinois residents with family income up to 600% of the poverty line (300% at rural and critical access hospitals).
rules.quote: You must have a family income and assets of not more than 600 percent of the federal poverty level
rules.notes: Source is the Illinois Hospital Report Card's description of Public Act 95-0965; its dollar examples use an older poverty guideline, and later amendments may change details such as the $300 service minimum. ilga.gov returned 503 and failed TLS verification on 2026-10-18, so the statute itself was not read.

rules.title: Charges capped at cost plus 35%
rules.short: If you qualify, charges can't be more than the hospital's cost plus 35%
rules.plain: If you qualify, the hospital can't charge you more than its costs plus 35%.
rules.quote: hospital charges to eligible uninsured cannot exceed the costs of the services plus 35 percent

rules.title: Yearly collections capped at 25% of income
rules.short: What a hospital collects in a year is capped at 25% of your family income
rules.plain: If you qualify, a hospital can collect at most 25% of your family income in a year.
rules.quote: no more than 25 percent of a patient's family income

rules.title: Apply within 60 days
rules.short: Apply within 60 days of your hospital stay or visit
rules.plain: You must apply for the uninsured discount within 60 days of leaving the hospital or getting the service.
rules.quote: You must apply for a discount within 60 days of the date of hospital discharge or service.
